notes.title: Hanako | 花子さん Coming Soon!
Missing Children | 行方不明 Coming Soon!
SAVE SYSTEM is here!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

Thank you all for playing Onryo. 
By popular demand, we've finally decided to implement the save system.

I know that this game has a lot of issues besides the save system, but we wanted to answer peoples' request as much as possible within our current reach.

We are still learning and we will implement the save system on the upcoming titles as well.

We seriously appreciate all the support.
We thank you all for the bug reports and reviews, both negative and positive. 

Chilla's Art brothers.
